method_name: DomainDrop-inspired ViT channel dropout for CoRP
preserved_official_semantics: linear source-domain discriminator over globally pooled features
channel score from the true domain classifier row
first min-max normalization over channels at every spatial position
second min-max normalization over pooled channel scores before WRS
one active block per training step with probability 0.8
binary mask recovery by numel divided by kept count
corp_adaptations: CNN feature map [B,C,H,W] is mapped to ViT block output [B,C,views,tokens]
the mask is shared across all three camera views and all CLS/patch tokens
block output channels are 384-dimensional embedding channels, not 1536-dimensional FFN neurons
dual classification KL is adapted to paired flow-velocity MSE using identical flow eps and tau
four evenly spaced ViT blocks 2,5,8,11 are used as a depth mapping of the four ResNet stages
all pilot conditions use deterministic style-balanced batches with 12 styles and 4 samples per style per batch
the pretrained backbone uses lr 1e-5 while the randomly initialized domain discriminators use a separate lr 1e-3 parameter group

formula_corrections.issue: the first score normalization flattened C,V,T instead of normalizing over C separately at every V,T position
formula_corrections.resolution: normalize with dim=1 and keepdim=True before adaptive average pooling
formula_corrections.equivalence_test: 50 randomized feature/weight/label/seed cases match the official WRS mask exactly

matched_random_control.only_difference: random channel scores instead of true-domain classifier scores

dgcd_reference.blocker: official code assumes fixed environment-wise sample groups; current mixed-style batches require a validated style-balanced construction before a faithful adaptation
